create_mst_maze_env: create a MSTMazeEnv single-agent maze environment with a configurable grid size and random start/goal positions
generate_maze_with_kruskals: generate a perfect maze using Kruskal's MST algorithm on a grid graph with randomized edges
sample_start_goal_positions: sample random start and goal positions from the four corner choices of the maze grid
create_perfect_maze_small: create a PerfectMazeSmall 11x11 maze environment instance with an optional random seed
register_maze_envs: register four maze environment variants (Small, Medium, Large, XL) with the gym registration system
